result:
The pre-existing `CharRangeTest.java` deletion was already present before I started (per the initial git status) — I only added `CharRangeAgentTest.java`.

Created `src/test/java/org/apache/commons/lang3/CharRangeAgentTest.java` with 31 JUnit 5 tests covering `CharRange`'s public API: the `is`/`isIn`/`isNot`/`isNotIn` factories (including endpoint-swap normalization), `contains(char)`, `contains(CharRange)` across all plain/negated combinations and boundary cases (empty-set negation, holes touching char-space boundaries), `equals`/`hashCode`, `toString` (including its caching via `assertSame`), and `iterator()`/`Iterable` behavior (plain and negated ranges, exhaustion, `remove()` throwing `UnsupportedOperationException`). All 31 tests pass via `mvn test -Dtest=CharRangeAgentTest`.
